title: Asymptotic Theory for Combining Dependent $p$-Values for Global Hypothesis Testing
summary: Combining $p$-values is a fundamental procedure in global hypothesis testing. In modern high-dimensional settings, however, component $p$-values often exhibit complex dependence and rely on asymptotic approximations rather than exact finite-sample uniform distributions. This paper establishes a unified asymptotic theory for weighted transformation statistics that decouples marginal finite-sample approximation error from the joint dependence structure.
